# oven_towel — realism QA repair

Horizontal dark stripes on cream woven cloth, doubled fold over oven bar; two instances.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f0808, f3369, f3379. Mean silhouette IoU 0.8032. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/oven_towel_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/oven_towel/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=B, proportions=B, colour_texture=B, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Replaced thick drape slabs with thin surface-following contact patches.
- Reduced exaggerated fold amplitude and refined placement/scale.
- Marked both independent towel instances deformable with a rigid fallback.
- Corrected left-towel placement by +50 mm world X after projecting both bindings in three full context frames.

## Remaining

- Fold geometry differs between the two real towels; shared canonical geometry is approximate.
- Second instance corrected by +50 mm world X from two source context views; no separate pixel-silhouette score.
- Cloth dynamics are not implemented.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.

- Replaced unexplained mass priors with explicit constituent volume × density or textile-area budgets; synchronized part masses and COM metadata.

- Mass, friction, restitution and stiffness remain estimates, not measured physical calibration.
- Coarse FEM scene is separate from the detailed GLB; dynamic skinning, bending/tearing and real constitutive calibration remain incomplete.
